ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across approximately 98% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized in small discrete clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black contiguous region across both lobes. One distinct high-contrast white cluster (mottling) located at the proximal medial region of the left lobe. Several isolated single-pixel high-intensity spots scattered on the distal third of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an obtuse pixel angle approximately between 110 and 120 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant pixel-amplitude variations (notches) detected on the left lobe approximately 30% from the distal tip. Right lobe exhibits higher frequency, lower amplitude peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetrical convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of small, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters on the medial surface of the right lobe and at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white depigmented patch on the inner proximal margin of the left lobe. Distinct notch/trauma mark on the trailing edge of the left lobe about one-third of the distance from the tip.
